notes: Complete named employee schedule; board/director, supplier, unnamed, aggregate and reconciliation rows excluded. Source names/initials retained without name expansion or identity inference; comma spacing normalized. Repeated names remain distinct observations.

The reported remuneration column is preserved as published and is not assumed to be base salary. Expenses remain separate. Printed dash/blank expense cells are null; printed numeric zeros remain 0. No amount is changed to reconcile controls.
No separate base-salary definition is imposed on the Remuneration column. Pension/other benefits, employer CPP/EI, accruals and other reconciliation items are not allocated to individual employees.
